gloss: the long days of spring; long daylight hours

definitions.gloss: the long days of spring; lengthening days
definitions.explanation: The long days of spring, when daylight has clearly lengthened and time seems to pass slowly and peacefully. A literary word and a seasonal word for spring in haiku.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日長|ひなが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoy the long days of spring.

examples.japanese: {日長|ひなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧、⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昼寝|ひるね}→昼寝：00106_hirune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On a long spring afternoon, I took a nap on the veranda.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{日長|ひなが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{楽|たの}しく→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Once March came the days grew longer, and my evening walks became much more pleasant.

notes:
Also written {日永|ひなが}. Although summer days are actually the longest, the word belongs to spring, when people first notice the days stretching out after winter. Its autumn counterpart is ⟦{夜長|よなが}→夜長：32304_yonaga⟧, the long nights.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日長|ひなが}: the long days of spring
- {日長|ひなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧: a long, leisurely spring day
- {日長|ひなが}⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧: all the long day (as in {日長|ひなが}{一日|いちにち}{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夜長|よなが}→夜長：32304_yonaga⟧: the long autumn nights — the seasonal counterpart
- ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: the days get longer — the ordinary spoken way to say it
